raw_segments.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Priya, the product manager for Festpal, our companion app for Technova.

raw_segments.text: My job is to break whatever you three build before the students do.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Perfect!

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Today we plan this two week sprint.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: The fest starts on march twentieth, so the app has to be on the Play Store before that.

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: Can we lock the tech stack first?

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: I don't want to keep going back and forth.

raw_segments.text: I'd vote for Flutter.

raw_segments.text: One code base gives us Android and iOS,

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: and my components map nicely to its widgets.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: From a testing point of view, one code base is great.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: Fewer platforms, fewer surprises.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Okay, then it's decided.

raw_segments.text: My only request is Firebase for login and push notifications, so I'm not writing authentication from scratch.

raw_segments.text: Agreed, we'll use Firebase for authentication and push notifications.

raw_segments.text: The must-haves are the event schedule,

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: workshop registration,

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: the campus map, and announcements.

raw_segments.text: What about the live leaderboard for the coding contest? It was in the original pitch.

raw_segments.text: The leaderboard needs real-time sync with the judging system.

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: That alone is a week of work, and it's hard to task without the real contest running.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Then let's cut the live leaderboard from version one and move it to version two.

raw_segments.text: That's on me.

raw_segments.text: I'll get the cleaned event list and venue data from the fest committee by Monday.

raw_segments.text: Great!

raw_segments.text: Then I'll build the event schedule and registration api,

raw_segments.text: and have it on staging by Friday.

raw_segments.text: I'll finish the high fidelity designs for the schedule and map screens by Wednesday.

raw_segments.text: Good call.

raw_segments.text: That reminds me of a risk.

raw_segments.text: Let's leave that open for now,

raw_segments.text: we don't have an answer today.

raw_segments.text: Nice try,

raw_segments.text: Arjun.

raw_segments.text: Moving on.

raw_segments.text: I'll email the sponsors for their logo files by Wednesday.

raw_segments.text: And I'll create the app icon and the splash screen by Friday in the Technova colors.

raw_segments.text: One more risk:

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: so if that breaks,

raw_segments.text: the registration API could slip by a couple of days.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: Noted.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Let's flag that as a risk and check in at Wednesday's stand-up.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: We should load test registration.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: Last year the portal crashed when workshop registrations opened.

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: How many users should we plan for?

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: Let's say two thousand students at the same time. I'll run the load test on the registration end point by March twelfth.

raw_segments.text: Will paid workshops be paid inside the app, or do we just link to the college payment portal?

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Honestly, I don't know.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Payments inside the app would need approval from the accounts office.

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: Linking out is much less work for me, but the experience is worse.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Let's keep that as an open question for now.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Last thing, the timeline.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: I propose a code freeze on March fourteenth and place our submission on March sixteenth.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: That gives me two clear days for regression testing. I can work with that.

raw_segments.speaker: B
raw_segments.text: Fine by me, as long as the event data arrives on Monday.

raw_segments.speaker: C
raw_segments.text: Works for me too.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Great, that's agreed then, code freeze on March fourteenth and place our submission on March sixteenth.

raw_segments.speaker: A
raw_segments.text: Thanks everyone, I'll send out the minutes and action items after this call.
